2026-10-07CHIndigenous Languages ActReappointment of the Commissioner of Indigenous Languages, on an interim basisApproval of the reappointment by the Minister of Canadian Heritage of Candice St-Aubin of Gatineau, Quebec, as Commissioner of Indigenous Languages, on an interim basis, to hold office during good behavior for a term of thirty-one days or until she is no longer required to act as Commissioner, whichever occurs first, effective October 12, 2026.N/A
subject: Reappointment of the Commissioner of Indigenous Languages, on an interim basis
precis: Approval of the reappointment by the Minister of Canadian Heritage of Candice St-Aubin of Gatineau, Quebec, as Commissioner of Indigenous Languages, on an interim basis, to hold office during good behavior for a term of thirty-one days or until she is no longer required to act as Commissioner, whichever occurs first, effective October 12, 2026.
